My Process

From Discovery to Optimization

01

Discovery

Understand the business, audience, goals, and current social media presence.

02

Research

Analyze competitors, audience behavior, market trends, and opportunities.

03

Strategy

Create content pillars, posting plan, KPIs, and campaign direction.

04

Content Creation

Design visuals, write captions, produce Reels, and prepare platform-ready content.

05

Publishing

Schedule content, maintain consistency, and optimize posting times.

06

Analyze

Track reach, engagement, profile visits, and audience behavior.

07

Optimize

Improve future content using insights, A/B testing, and continuous optimization.

A continuous loop, not a one-time plan.

My Philosophy
"

Great social media isn't about posting more — it's about posting with purpose.

Every piece of content should educate, build trust, or inspire meaningful action, not simply fill a content calendar.

Strategy always comes before design because thoughtful content creates lasting relationships, not just temporary engagement.

— Ivy Sabandija
